caption: 配套首页 · 开奖优先，减少常驻文字
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished native Android mobile APP SCREEN edge-to-edge portrait1080x2340, no phone bezel, no browser, no perspective, no poster composition. Chinese offline 3D lottery data app "叁序". This is a design proposal using a real historical sample, not a promotional sales page. Same precise modern Chinese sans visual family throughout. Palette white #FFFFFF, clean near-white #F7F7F5, charcoal #242424, medium-gray #716F6D, one strong red #D9363E. NO BLUE, CYAN, beige parchment, gradient, gold, neon, illustrations, confetti, cards within cards, verbose explanatory paragraphs. Native Android Material navigation and touch targets. Clear editorial hierarchy but a working APP, never a newspaper.
STRUCTURE in one viewport:
1) slim status bar9:41. Compact header with "叁序" atleft bold26dp, a small red THREE-STROKE brandmark beside the name; label"福彩3D" modest gray inline, settings icon right48dp.
2) A large calm white result region, NOT a floating giant bordered card: row "第2026263期" left and "09月30日" right, then a dominant horizontal triplet of solid red flat circles containing white digits9 8 7, three circles64dp each. Labels 百位 十位 个位 small beneath each. This is a LOTTERY RESULT display, not interactive buttons. A quiet single row below "和值24   跨度2   组六", and a small text-link "开奖详情 →" aligned right. Make the whole result easy to read in one glance and leave clear breathing space.
3) Compact gray-neutral horizontal trial row: "试机号" left, black monospaced "643" incenter, small "2026264期" under/alongside, refreshiconright. Distinct visual treatment prevents confusion with red formal result.
4) "最近开奖" section heading and "全部 →" right. Exactly THREE aligned, compact history rows on white: "2026262  09.29" and spaced red digits "3 4 7"; "2026261  09.28" and "5 1 1"; "2026260  09.27" and "6 1 9". Use typography and hairline row separation, no individual cards, no circular highlights on every history digit.
5) Near bottom one compact row with folder-outlineicon, "我的方案", small "1期待开奖", chevron. Below/alongside it ONE well-proportioned prominent red primary button labeled "开始选号 →", full width if needed, but not oversized. Its wording makes next action obvious, no slogans.
6) Persistent bottom5navigation Homeactive red: 首页 走势 选号 方案 彩报, coherent outlineicons+text, plus Androidgesturebar.
Only real concise functional Chinese labels. Avoid all irrelevant sales figures, temperature/omission paragraphs, promotional messages. Use variable visual weight and whitespace to let eyes land on987 first, then history, then action. Keep every section inside393x851dp screen equivalent with reasonable minimum48dp touch targets. Make this look like a careful human designer's finished APP interface.
